entries.note: Noordeen 2013 (PMID 23939904) quote verbatim in abstract. Opener should sit at the duck's first class use: REP 101 started 2009-01 (NCT02646163) on REP 2055 optimised in DHBV ducks (Al-Mahtab 2016 intro); proxy allowed. Status unchanged.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: cell opens untested at model_first_use_year, proxy allowed; REP 101 (NCT02646163, start 2009-01) used duck-optimised REP 2055, so 2009 year accepted. Status unchanged; not the track's latest entry.

entries.note: Al-Mahtab 2016 (PMC4892580) full text: discussion draws the duck parallel in its own words ('parallels the sustained control of DHBV infection ... in ducks'), so comparison_stated true holds. Abstract says 3/8, discussion 3/7. Retrodiction caveat is a rule question.

Bazinet 2020 quote verbatim (PubMed abstract); Roehl 2017 prediction verbatim in PMC5466589. But no status change on the track and 'strengthens' is defined for a second miss only: fold into entry 2's note rather than a new entry.
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: status same is agreed (rule 7/#127); does #127's strengthens, defined for a second miss, allow a same-to-same entry (REP 401), or must the datum fold into entry 2 / patient_trials?

entries.note: Schoneweis 2018 (PMID 29126900, epub 2017-11-08) abstract: woodchuck quote and the stated duck/patient-vs-rodent comparison both verbatim. Retrodiction that failed to reproduce patients, contra. Abstract only; whether decision 10 overrides #73 (class never relied on woodchuck) is a rule question.
Same source, HBV-transgenic mouse sentence verbatim in abstract. Own model_id justified (different system). Contra as a failed retrodiction; same #73 question as entry 4.
Same source, SCID-Hu sentence verbatim in abstract. REP 2055 is the REP 101 member, product_in_model true. Contra as a failed retrodiction. Abstract-level only.

Blanchet 2019 (PMID 30771404) 'recapitulation' sentence verbatim in abstract; Boulon 2020 (PMID 32585322) 'recapitulates ... in treated patients' also verbatim. Retro, not same. model_kind ex_vivo is a schema gap (no in-vitro value).

Debing 2024 (PMID 38401714, epub 2024-02-23) both quoted phrases verbatim in abstract. Retro with partial fits. Whether a re-engineered Pekin-duck protocol by another lab is a new model_id or the dhbv-pekin-duck track is a rule question; could not read full text.

Noordeen 2015 (PMC4641618) quote verbatim; 10 mg/kg i.p. and the weekly PS-ON-style regimen confirmed in full text. Entry year 2015 conflicts with its own model_first_use_year 2013; the cell opens at first class use (2009 proxy, 2013 at latest). Status unchanged.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: opener belongs at model_first_use_year (2013 own field; 2009 proxy via REP 101 start), not 2015. Status untested: duck stated no human exposure target (rule 5 no_prediction; decision 4 dose table).

entries.note: Roehl 2017 (PMC5466589) full text: cynomolgus tolerated 6 months at up to 9 mg/kg with no liver, kidney, calcium or haematology change; 27 mg/kg lowered albumin and raised BUN/creatinine. Margin stated; untested opener correct. No NOAEL named.

Bazinet 2020 quote verbatim in PubMed abstract (Europe PMC abstract truncated). REP 401 dosed 250 mg weekly inside the 9 mg/kg margin, tolerability unaltered, drug worked: same with margin_stated. Margin is anchored on the clinical dose, not the duck's 10 mg/kg/day (rule question).
Same opener as engagement 1; move to 2009 (REP 101 start on the duck, NCT02646163 start 2009-01; Al-Mahtab 2016 intro). Status unchanged.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: duck opener moves to 2009 proxy (REP 101 start 2009-01 on duck-optimised REP 2055, NCT02646163). Status unchanged untested; same follows in 2016.

entries.note: Al-Mahtab 2016 abstract quote verbatim; full text confirms REP 101 primary = tolerability, secondary = antiviral response (poc_gate), and the discussion states the duck parallel (6/11 ducks, 55%). within_2x holds (55% vs 38%). Registry: no results posted, first posted 2016-01-05.

Noordeen 2013 toxicity sentence verbatim in abstract. Opener year to 2009 as for the other duck openers. Note Noordeen 2015 measured duck ALT/AST/GGT (methods); a duck-vs-REP 401 flare pairing is possible but I could not verify the duck result text. Status unchanged.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: opener year to 2009 proxy. Status untested and track's latest: duck gave body-weight tolerability only, no margin or named harm compared with patients (rule 5 no_prediction).

entries.rule: decision 10 (a model run after the patient result was known is retro, never same); decision 4 (heavy-metal symptoms a harm the unexposed monkey could not show)
entries.note: Field status, value retro in 2017 (new entry after the untested opener, before the 2020 same): PMC5466589 Discussion verbatim sets 6-month cynomolgus serum calcium unchanged beside unchanged patient calcium/magnesium (Al-Mahtab 2016). Comparison_stated true, retrodiction true. | superseded: confirmed (): Roehl 2017 quote verbatim. Full text also sets monkey calcium (unchanged at doses exceeding clinical) against the Bangladeshi mineral-deficiency symptoms in its own words, so a stated calcium retrodiction exists here; its status (untested under #35/#72 vs contra under 10) is a rule question.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 10: Roehl 2017 Discussion states 6-month cyno serum calcium unchanged beside unchanged Bangladesh patient calcium/magnesium; REP 2165 designed after those trials, so a stated retrodiction reproducing patients is retro, not untested.

entries.note: Bazinet 2020 'did not alter tolerability' verbatim in abstract. Monkey prediction (no drug-induced liver, kidney, haematological harm) held; NAP-arm transaminase flares tracked HBsAg loss in infected patients, which an uninfected cynomolgus cannot show. same + partial defensible; see rule question 9.

PMC5479567 full text (epub 2017-06-21): quote verbatim in Introduction. Own track justified (HBV-infected human cells, no endosomal-release agent, opposite prediction to HepG2.2.15/UNC7938). Untested opener at first class use; model_kind ex_vivo is the known schema gap.

PMC5479567 full text: quote verbatim in Discussion; post-inoculation REP 2055 0.1-5 uM: 'no effect on viral markers'. Failed retrodiction, contra; source's endosomal-sequestration explanation is a model limit, not an untested trial condition (#35/#72). Same #73 question as entries 4-6.

PMC5341074 full text (2017-03-08): quote verbatim in abstract. Own track justified (uninfected cells, immune readout). Three members plus REP 2006 at 0.05-50 uM confirmed in Methods. Untested opener at first class use; ex_vivo schema gap as before.

PMC5341074 full text: quote verbatim minus ref superscript 38. Stelma 2015 unindexed (Europe PMC 0 hits): patient cytokine rise cannot be sized or attributed to NAP vs pegIFN; harm-level null was a stated prediction (#58) and held. Retro + partial stands.

missing: ALG-010133 (Aligos STOPS, LNA-modified phosphorothioate oligonucleotide polymer, same HBsAg-secretion mechanism): Phase 1 ALG-010133-101 (NCT04485663, terminated) showed 'insufficient activity against hepatitis B virus' at the projected efficacious dose (400 mg, liver exposure >3x EC90), Aligos press release 2022-01-06 (tier 5, https://investor.aligos.com/news-releases/news-release-details/aligos-halting-further-development-stopstm-drug-candidate-alg), after prospective in-vitro HBV cell-model predictions (Aligos AASLD 2020 poster, https://www.aligos.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/ALG-010133-S-Antigen-Transport-inhibiting-Oligonucleotide-Polymer-STOPS-effectively-inhibits-HBsAg-secretion-in-multiple-Hepatitis-B-Virus-HBV-cell-models.pdf). Not a listed member (class_programs 3), so unscorable under decision 12 unless the register places STOPS in this mechanism; flagged as rule question 7.

HepaRG / primary human hepatocyte entry assay for REP 2055 and REP 2139 (Guillot 2017, doi 10.1371/journal.pone.0179697, PMC5479567): a human-cell model used for the class with no track in the draft; likely an untested track (no patient comparison seen; abstract not read within budget).

DHBV-infected primary duck hepatocyte assay (Noordeen 2013 in vitro, doi 10.1128/AAC.01003-13), the in-vitro arm the class entered on alongside the in-vivo duck; no patient comparison, so an untested ex_vivo opener at most.

Roehl 2017 itself states a monkey-vs-patient calcium comparison (PMC5466589 discussion: 'showed no changes in serum calcium at doses exceeding those used clinically', against the Bangladeshi mineral-deficiency symptoms of Al-Mahtab 2016); the draft records it as an untested pairing rather than a stated comparison.
rule_questions: Opener dating (rule 7, #112): may model_first_use_year be a proxy earlier than the model's first admissible publication when tier-1/3 sources show the class entered patients on that model (REP 101 start 2009-01 on duck work published 2013/2015)?

Retrodiction on the entry model (decision 10): the duck therapeutic prediction (Noordeen 2015) was published after REP 101 completed (2012-12) and after REP 102; the duck was the model the class entered on, but its admissible record post-dates the patient result. Prospective same (as drafted) or retro?

A second prospective match on the same track outside efficacy (REP 2165 ~ REP 2139 in ducks, confirmed in REP 401): 'strengthens' (#127) covers a second miss only and patient_trials is efficacy-only. Where does a second match go?

Decision 10 vs #73: a post-hoc model the class never relied on (woodchuck, HBV-transgenic mouse, SCID-Hu) that fails to reproduce the human result: contra under decision 10, or not scorable because the class never relied on it (#73)?

Model identity (rule 8): is a re-engineered protocol of the same species/virus system by another lab (Debing 2024: s.c. dosing, experimentally infected adult ducks) a new model_id, or the dhbv-pekin-duck track? If the same track, a retro entry after a prospective same reads as a downgrade on the strip.

Decision 16 anchor: is the 'effective exposure' the model's (duck 10 mg/kg/day i.p., not shown tolerated in cynomolgus at that weekly load; 27 mg/kg altered BUN/creatinine/albumin) or the clinical dose (250-500 mg weekly, inside the 9 mg/kg margin)? The draft's dose same rests on the clinical anchor.

Class boundary (decision 12): Aligos' STOPS ALG-010133 shares the HBsAg-secretion mechanism and failed Phase 1 at the projected efficacious dose, but is not a tile member. Does the register treat STOPS as this mechanism, and if not, is a same-mechanism non-member failure recorded anywhere?
Schema: model_kind has no in-vitro value; hepatoma-line assays (HepG2.2.15, HepaRG) are entered as ex_vivo.

Safety (decision 4): a host-immune transaminase flare tied to antigen clearance in infected patients (95% of REP 401 NAP recipients, Bazinet 2021) that an uninfected toxicology species cannot show: is it 'a harm the species could have shown', or is same + partial right?

Safety/dose: Roehl 2017's own calcium statement against the Bangladeshi symptoms is a stated retrodiction (monkeys did not reproduce REP 2055 hypocalcaemia, 2016). Contra under decision 10, or untested under #35/#72 because the sponsor attributes the symptoms to endemic heavy-metal load and a different member/salt?

[models check] Safety retrodiction on an uninfected human-cell track (Real 2017, safety 5): the source states both a biomarker-level mismatch (serum cytokines rose in all REP 102 patients at therapeutic doses; cells secreted only at 50 uM) and a harm-level match (no pro-inflammatory clinical effects). Which level does decision 10's 'reproduces the human data' test: retro + partial as drafted, or contra?

[models check] Magnitude bin for a model null against a multilog patient effect (Guillot 2017, engagement 10: no post-inoculation HBsAg change vs 2-7 log10 in REP 101/102): off_by_>5x as drafted, or the null bin? Decision 11 does not say which applies to a failed retrodiction.
